name: Birdwatcher Margaret

intro.text: Shh. Eider ducks. The males are black and white and the females are mottled brown, and they're called Cuddy ducks after St Cuthbert, who protected them. Now. Your move.

win: Well flown. That's thrown my count off entirely.
after: A birdwatcher counts, notes, waits. A trainer does all that and then shouts. I am learning.
